summary:
The four plots are all flat-roofed and placed on the # cells. The ITB is a 50x50 shaft with chamfered corners, a bronze grid of brown_terracotta and brown stained glass, and a three-step crown with lit rims to y 202, with red aircraft lights at y 203..204. Hall 1 is a 210x224 box with pale piers every 7 blocks and skylight strips, and its south front has a canopy porch, flags and the lettering.
The Hyatt is a beige banded slab with stepped ends and a lit GRAND HYATT crown, over a podium with a porte-cochere. TICC is a dark glass box inside a ring of 3x3 quartz piers under a heavy overhanging roof, with a grand stair on its east front. These are the shapes, colours and lit edges that make each building recognisable from a high south-east view at dusk.
